title: Square Enix Announces Kingdom Hearts IV Game's Switch 2 Release With Trailer; Kingdom Hearts Collection [I~III] for Switch 2, PS5, Xbox X|S, PC
content: Square Enix announced during the Nintendo Direct livetsream on Tuesday that it will release its Kingdom Hearts IV game for Nintendo Switch 2 on the same day as the releases for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
author: ANN

title: 'Clevatess II' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Third Promo
content: • The official website for the Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou ( Clevatess Season 2 ) television anime revealed additional cast, the opening theme, and a third promotional video on Tuesday. The second season is scheduled to premiere on July 8 at 10:30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Finally Gives Fans The Ending They’ve Been Waiting For
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was such a success that the anime adaptation of CD Projekt Red’s video game universe gave Cyberpunk 2077 a major shot in the arm. title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Gets Switch 2 Remake
content: Nintendo announced during its Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday a remake for the 1998 Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . The remake will launch for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Crunchryoll’s Biggest Anime Hypes Series Finale After 7 Years With New Trailer
content: One of Crunchyroll’ s biggest anime franchises is gearing up for its grand finale after seven years, and the anime is hyping up what to expect from the series finale with a new trailer.
author: ComicBook

title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Anime Debuts on July 11
content: Crunchyroll will stream the anime in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, and India. Pony Canyon announced that the series will stream worldwide.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Hottest New Anime Star Is in a League of Their Own
content: New anime emerging from Shonen Jump magazine is a common occurrence every season, and Spring 2026 is no different. In fact, Spring 2026 has delivered one of the most unique shonen anime in years with a narrative few would have expected.
author: ComicBook

title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day Anime's 2nd Video Unveils Theme Songs, July 7 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Nachi Aono 's I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day ( Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai ) manga revealed on Tuesday the anime's second promotional video, key visual, theme songs, and July 7 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Anime's Trailer Unveils milet's Opening Song, More Cast
content: The staff for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series started streaming the anime's full trailer video, and announced five more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Opening Theme Song, July 7 Premiere
content: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day anime revealed a new visual featuring the main cast along with a new trailer, opening theme song, and a July 7 premiere date. ReoNa is singing the opening theme song titled “Amore.” Yumi Uchiyama and Ai Kayano are also joining the cast as Fran and Omi, respectively.
author: Anime Corner
